blurb: Guests can enjoy private wine tastings, guided vineyard tours, and virtual tasting experiences led by the owner or estate hosts. Experiences include wine and cheese pairings, Polaris tours of the vineyard, and barrel tastings. The estate is located on a 17-acre vineyard in the Willow Creek AVA near Paso Robles, CA.
extraNote: Open by appointment only; schedule tasting ahead · Holiday closures: Nov 26, Dec 24-25, Jan 1, July 4 · Clos Solène Estate Winery, 2040 Niderer Road, Paso Robles, CA
